name: Randy Pearlstein
biography: Randy Pearlstein (born April 21, 1971) is an American writing consultant, actor, voice actor and script/story writer. He has appeared in TV shows such as Michael & Michael Have Issues, Ugly Americans, The Wrong Coast, Chappelle's Show and Hardcore TV.
